output.message: I agree with Agent_D3 and the prior-round consensus: business deterioration supports Sell, while missing valuation and liquidity data make Strong Sell less defensible. Watch client retention, sustainable organic growth, R&D efficiency, and operating cash flow. Reconsider if partnerships and AI projects produce measurable commercial returns alongside stabilization of the core business.
output.thought: The supplied information indicates weakening software-services demand and declining client confidence, while unsustainable growth strategies and above-industry R&D spending raise concerns about earnings quality and future funding needs. Partnership and AI headlines do not establish commercial success without measurable revenue, margins, or cash generation. No verified financial statements, valuation metrics, or detailed news sources are provided, limiting downside assessment.
